QuestionStmt.S: A coil has inductive reactance 3 H. The ratio of its reactance when it is first connected to an a.c. source and then to d.c. source is

Solution.S: Inductive reactance $X_L = \omega L = 2\pi f L$. For an a.c. source, $X_L$ is finite (given as 3 H). For a d.c. source, frequency $f = 0$, so $X_L = 0$. The ratio of reactance for a.c. to d.c. is $\frac{X_L(\text{ac})}{X_L(\text{dc})} = \frac{3}{0}$, which is undefined/infinite. Thus, the correct option is C: infinite.
